description: Annual financial statements (DFP) of a Brazilian listed company from CVM open data: balance sheet, income statement, cash flow and value added, as account lines with CVM account codes and Portuguese labels, in full BRL. Identify the company by cnpj (e.g. "00.000.000/0001-91" or 14 digits) or by name (e.g. "Petrobras"; an ambiguous name returns candidates instead of a guess). year is the fiscal reference year (default: latest loaded). scope is "consolidated" or "individual" (default: consolidated when the company filed one, else individual -- the response says which). Only the latest filing version is kept; the response states it. statement narrows to one of BPA (assets), BPP (liabilities and equity), DRE (income), DFC_MI / DFC_MD (cash flow indirect / direct), DVA (value added). max_depth (default 2) limits account-code depth so a default call returns the headline lines; raise it for sub-accounts. Results page with limit/offset and report truncated/total_matching. A company or year not in the data returns found:false with data_as_of, never an empty success.

cnpj.description: Company CNPJ, formatted or 14 digits. Pass cnpj or name.

name.description: Company name, e.g. "Petrobras", "Itau Unibanco". Accents optional.

scope.description: Default consolidated if filed, else individual.

year.description: Fiscal reference year, e.g. 2024. Default: latest loaded for that company.
